question.text: What is the minimum denomination for issuance of Commercial Paper (CP) in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Commercial Papers are issued in denominations of Rs. 5 lakh and multiples thereof, with maturities between 7 days and one year. CPs are short-term unsecured instruments used by corporates with the required credit rating to raise working-capital funds. The Trap: Rs. 1 lakh, Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 25 lakh are not the prescribed minimum CP denomination — the minimum is Rs. 5 lakh. Note: A credit rating from an approved agency is required for CP issuance.
